subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should the remaining display-manifest path preserve a complete catalog contract, move to a bounded or paginated contract, or be split into a separately tracked follow-up before this performance issue is considered complete?
rationale: The merged partial work intentionally excluded this path, and choosing a bound affects which GitHub-backed publisher data callers may receive; source inspection cannot safely choose that product and compatibility contract alone.

options.title: Define and bound the manifest path
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a bounded or paginated display-manifest contract with focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Retain complete manifests intentionally
options.body: Document why this caller requires complete catalogs and narrow this issue’s completion scope to the already-merged paths.

options.title: Split the remaining contract
options.body: Create a focused follow-up for display-manifest behavior and close this umbrella only after that follow-up is explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Define and bound the manifest path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a bounded or paginated display-manifest contract with focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the audit, implemented the merged partial redesign, and documented the explicit remaining boundary.
